label: RUNX1::MECOM

sections.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 861 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: MECOM encodes EVI1/MDS1-associated transcriptional regulators of hematopoiesis.

audit_evidence.location: NCBI Gene 2122 RefSeq/Alliance summary, inspected cached esummary record
audit_evidence.scope: Normal partner description only; not primary fusion evidence.

sections.text: RUNX1::MECOM can occur in de novo AML: a pediatric acute myelomonocytic leukemia case had t(3;21) and Sanger-confirmed RUNX1::MECOM alongside RUNX1::RPL22.

audit_evidence.scope: Direct diagnosis and sequenced fusion; does not generalize a single case to all myeloid contexts.

sections.text: MECOM-rearranged AML is assigned adverse genetic risk under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.

audit_evidence.location: Table 6, 2022 ELN risk classification by genetics at initial diagnosis
audit_evidence.scope: Favorable CBF; intermediate t(9;11); adverse DEK::NUP214, other KMT2A, MECOM and KAT6A::CREBBP categories.

report_comment.text: RUNX1 encodes the DNA-binding alpha subunit of core-binding factor, a regulator of hematopoiesis. MECOM encodes EVI1/MDS1-associated transcriptional regulators of hematopoiesis. RUNX1::MECOM can occur in de novo AML: a pediatric acute myelomonocytic leukemia case had t(3;21) and Sanger-confirmed RUNX1::MECOM alongside RUNX1::RPL22. MECOM-rearranged AML is assigned adverse genetic risk under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria.
